The '''2022 Retro League Event 4''' was the fourth event of the [[2022 Retro League]] on [[GEMP]], played in [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] format. It ran from late July to early September 2022; 46 players registered, and [[Jared Napolitano]] won with a 6-0 record.<ref name="t80297" /><ref name="t80048" />

== Format ==
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Site:''' [[GEMP]]
* '''Dates:''' late July – early September 2022
* '''Structure:''' six games of Swiss, one game a week, scored by strength of schedule; 45-minute timers per side<ref name="t80048" /><ref name="t80194" />
* '''Players:''' 46
* '''Winner:''' [[Jared Napolitano]]
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Steve Sanders]]<ref name="t80296" />
